name: 44481 · Warren, OH
findings: ZIP 44481 (Warren) has 62 nonprofit organizations. 20 of them (32%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 16 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 44481 (Warren) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
30% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 44481 (Warren) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.1 times the typical level).
